fixed_recipe.composite: arithmetic mean of the defined transport, building, and POI component predictions; undefined components are excluded entirely
fixed_recipe.poi: use the frozen V2 POI component estimate as supplied; its internal facility/establishment half arithmetic is not modified
fixed_recipe.zero_defined_rule: for each candidate and region, use the median of that candidate's composite predictions among rows in the same region with at least one defined top-level component; fail if a region has no defined rows
fixed_recipe.template_only_rows: zero fill for 415 eastern-WA formatting rows; not part of the 9,379 scored region rows

candidate_a_rule_grounded_mask.transport_defined: overture_named_road_km_5070 > 0 in reports/candidates/road_topology_candidate.csv; this is the provided-data indicator for a named-highway-class road object
candidate_a_rule_grounded_mask.poi_defined: any raw_fire_count, raw_ems_count, raw_schools_count > 0 OR all_overture_poi_count > 0 in reports/candidates/poi_confidence_weighted.csv; no facility/establishment object means POI undefined
candidate_a_rule_grounded_mask.mask_rule: mask a top-level component undefined when its corresponding provided-data object-presence condition above is false

eligible_mask_sources.V2: reports/v2-defined-mask-audit.json component masks; source components are road_topology_candidate.route_reference_transport_defined, building_morphology.building_defined, and poi_confidence_weighted.v2_raw_poi_defined
eligible_mask_sources.C2: reports/gap-estimates.csv transport_defined, building_defined, and poi_defined flags

candidate_b_existing_mask_selection.selection_rule: for each source, compute mean absolute difference (percentage points) between its regional share with at least one undefined top-level component and the organizer-published regional share; select the complete source mask family with lower mean absolute difference; exact tie resolves to V2; this rule is frozen before candidate B is measured

common_undefined_share_gate.principle: tolerance equals the mean absolute regional share disagreement between the two pre-existing independent hard-mask systems V2 and C2; this is a predictor-disagreement tolerance, not a rounding tolerance
common_undefined_share_gate.acceptance: for every new candidate and every region, absolute difference between hard any-undefined share and the published share must be <= the one global tolerance above
common_undefined_share_gate.prior_candidate_exclusion: the previously measured A1_rules_composite_20261028 is not retroactively evaluated/admitted under this new tolerance; it remains blocked with two zero-defined rows
